args.title: Update password reset link to use the correct base URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The current implementation uses 'http://localhost:3000' as the base URL for password reset emails, which causes the links to be non-functional for end-users. This change updates the base URL to use the value from the environment variable 'PUBLIC_URL', ensuring that the correct URL is used in the password reset emails.
